Image budget arithmetic is checked (V4-01, deny(arithmetic_side_effects) on flatten.rs/paint.rs/render_bounds.rs/raster.rs; checked_mul/checked_add throughout); every image hayro can decode (every /Subtype /Image stream + its /SMask /Mask, every inline image of every content-role stream) is pre-sized by image_bounds against max_decoded_bytes and max_render_image_bytes using the largest of both key spellings and the codec's own header dims (raster.rs codec_dims), and refused when sample data under-backs the declared samples. paint.rs charges each drawn image's declared pixels to an aggregate page decode budget (64 rasters) before drawing more. Documented residual (DESCRIPTOR renderer_residual): hayro CPU is not cancellable, codec-internal bitmaps (JBIG2 symbol/halftone, JPX tiles) bounded only by the decoders (65535/60000 per side), font programs parsed by skrifa/read-fonts without the nesting scan. new_findings.file_line: src/flatten_purge.rs:732-734 (trailer roots pushed with certain=true); src/flatten_purge.rs:519-535,559-590 (follow/traverse propagate certain through plain references); src/flatten_purge.rs:772 (gone = sources NOT reached, so a reached source is never pruned) and :795-796 (painted_sources_kept = live AND NOT certain, so a certain source is not reported); src/sanitized_save.rs:1364-1372 (region_flattened requires only painted_sources_kept empty)
new_findings.evidence: A painted region image/form is in a flat page's sources (flatten.rs isolate closure). If the SAME object is also referenced by a non-drawing plain reference that survives in the kept document (for example catalog /AF associated files, a /Names /EmbeddedFiles or /Dests name tree, /OutputIntents), the usage analysis reaches it through follow() from the trailer roots with certain=true, so it is neither in `gone` (not pruned, flatten_purge.rs:772) nor in painted_sources_kept (filtered out at :795-796 because certain). region_flattened()/region_cleared() then read true while the unredacted source stays byte-for-byte in the file and is recoverable by an image/attachment extractor. This is NOT content a viewer draws on the flattened page (the prompt's finding bar and the R13 class), and it requires an unusual document whose region source is doubly referenced from a kept catalog structure; the DESCRIPTOR purge section already documents an analogous OBJR/structure-root residual. Reasoned from the code paths; not executed.
new_findings.remediation: Treat a painted region source that is reachable only through non-drawing references as kept-for-uncertainty (report NotProven::PaintedSourceKept), or scope the 'certain' mark to draw-reachability (a source reached only by plain references is reported, not silently kept); or document this recoverability residual in DESCRIPTOR redaction.flatten.purge alongside the OBJR residual. Optional: a test with a region image also listed under catalog /AF.
